name: Águas Lindas de Goiás

queries.query: Aguas Lindas de Goias cadastral parcels map official Brazil
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official IBGE municipal/urban-sector mapping and the official City of Águas Lindas site. The municipal cadastral service lead is the Prodata SIG portal linked by the city, but no anonymous parcel-vector endpoint was exposed.

queries.query: Águas Lindas de Goiás cadastro imobiliário mapa parcelas geoprocessamento site oficial
queries.result: Busca em fontes oficiais encontrou o Código Tributário municipal, que exige a inscrição dos imóveis urbanos no Cadastro Imobiliário, e um edital municipal para atualização do cadastro imobiliário fiscal urbano com agrimensura/geoprocessamento. O site da cidade vincula Emitir IPTU e Emitir Certidão de Imóvel ao Prodata SIG; o ponto de entrada público atual é protegido por login.

registryEvidence.custodian: The Prefeitura Municipal of Águas Lindas de Goiás is evidenced as the local Cadastro Imobiliário custodian for municipal fiscal purposes; Prodata is the linked SIG service provider/portal. No public local parcel registry endpoint was qualified in this attempt.
registryEvidence.scope: Municipal legislation and procurement establish a local fiscal property cadastre and geoprocessing work, but general legal/procurement prose is not evidence of an anonymous parcel API or downloadable parcel geometry. registryFound remains null because the current public SIG route requires login.

parcelDiscovery.source: Municipal Prodata SIG entrypoint and official IBGE mapping were checked; no safe anonymous parcel response was returned.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200 official municipal site map; it links Emitir IPTU and Emitir Certidão de Imóvel to the Prodata SIG portal. No parcel geometry or public schema was present in this page.

HTTP 200 login page. Current JavaScript/UI exposes user/password login and possible CAPTCHA/MFA paths; no login, credentials, CAPTCHA interaction, or private route probing was attempted. No anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.
HTTP 200 official IBGE download index; municipal map PDF is general cartography, not a cadastral parcel-vector service, and was not retained as a parcel sample.
Official IBGE urban-sector map reviewed; it shows census block/face cartography, not cadastral parcel identities or a parcel API. No parcel polygon retained.

parcelDiscovery.note: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted or used as an absence test. No exact-point parcel query was issued because no public parcel layer was exposed. A login wall or absent map extent is not evidence of citywide absence.

uncertainty: The municipal fiscal cadastre clearly exists by official law and procurement evidence, but current anonymous parcel-vector access and schema remain unresolved.
The Prodata SIG may expose parcel data after authorized authentication or through a supported interactive client; that route was not used.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, certificate, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No sample GeoJSON was written because no safe native parcel identity plus full polygon was returned.
Packet completion is not source integration or runtime admission.
